newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union offer price at 290p/share.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union offer price at 290p/share.

text.p: Norwich Union said on Sunday that the public offer price for its shares has been set at 290 pence per share.
The members' offer price, which reflects the discount of 25 pence per share, is 265 pence per share, it said.
"The pricing reflects the strength of demand from both Norwich Union members and international investors," Norwich said in a statement.
The institutional offer for the insurance group was covered more than 10 times and the members offer nearly four times.
Many applicants may well be disappointed at the number of shares they actually receive with sharp scaling back in allocations.
Members applying for up to 1,500 pounds ($2,450) worth of shares will get their full allotment but a 10,000 pound application will get just 22 percent of shares asked for.
On the start of trading on the stock market on Monday members will hold just over three-quarters of Norwich Union's share capital.
Those lucky enough to get shares may be tempted to cash-in immediately with bookmakers City Index predicting the shares to race as high as 353 pence by the end of the first day.

The offer raised the 2.4 billion pounds planned and will value the group at over 5.5 billion pounds making it Britain's third largest quoted insurer behind Prudential Corp and Royal & Sun Alliance. ($ = 0.611 British Pounds)
